name: Backpack
desc: Holds 1 cubic foot / 30 pounds of gear.

name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
desc: As an action, spill them over a 10-foot square next to you. A creature that comes into the area makes a DC 10 Dexterity save or falls prone.

name: Block and Tackle
desc: Lets you hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
desc: As an action, scatter them over a 5-foot square next to you. A creature that comes into the square makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or stops moving, takes 1 piercing damage and moves 10 feet slower until it regains a hit point.

name: Candle
desc: Bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for another 5 feet, for 1 hour.

name: Component Pouch
desc: Holds the material components for your spells.

name: Crowbar
desc: Advantage on Strength checks where its leverage helps.

name: Healer's Kit
desc: Ten uses. As an action, spend one use to stabilize a creature at 0 hit points without a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

name: Lamp
desc: Bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet. Burns a flask of oil for 6 hours.

name: Lantern, bullseye
desc: Bright light in a 60-foot cone and dim light for another 60 feet. Burns a flask of oil for 6 hours.

name: Lantern, hooded
desc: Bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for another 30 feet. Burns a flask of oil for 6 hours.

name: Oil (flask)
desc: Fuel for a lamp or lantern: one flask burns for 6 hours.

name: Torch
desc: Bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for another 20 feet. Burns for 1 hour.

name: Waterskin
desc: Holds 4 pints of liquid (5 lb when full).

name: Acid (vial)
desc: As an action, throw it at a creature within 20 feet (ranged attack, improvised weapon): 2d6 acid damage on a hit.

name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
desc: As an action, throw it at a creature within 20 feet (ranged attack, improvised weapon). On a hit the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it uses an action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to put out the flames.

name: Antitoxin (vial)
desc: Drinking it gives advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour.

name: Holy Water (flask)
desc: As an action, splash it on a creature within 20 feet (ranged attack, improvised weapon). A fiend or undead takes 2d6 radiant damage on a hit.

name: Poison, basic (vial)
desc: As an action, coat a slashing or piercing weapon (or three pieces of ammunition). For a minute, the next creature it hits makes a DC 10 Constitution save or takes 1d4 poison damage; then the coating is spent.

name: Net
desc: A martial weapon you throw (5/15 ft) as an action, the only attack you make that turn. A Large or smaller creature it hits is restrained until it (or someone next to it) breaks free with a DC 10 Strength check, or cuts it with 5 slashing damage (AC 10). No effect on Huge or bigger creatures.

name: Silvered Weapon
desc: Coated in silver (100 gp on top of the weapon). It gets past the resistance of creatures, such as lycanthropes, that only shrug off weapons that are neither magical nor silvered.

name: Silvered Ammunition
desc: Priced per piece (100 gp for ten). Shots get past the resistance of creatures that only shrug off weapons that are neither magical nor silvered. Silver stays on a piece that hits.

name: Ornamental stone (10 gp)
desc: A small, pretty stone. Gems and art keep their full value: a shop pays the whole price.

name: Semiprecious stone (50 gp)
desc: A polished semiprecious stone. Sells for its full value.

name: Fine gemstone (100 gp)
desc: A clear, well-cut gemstone. Sells for its full value.

name: Precious gem (500 gp)
desc: A large precious gem. Sells for its full value.

name: Rare gem (1,000 gp)
desc: A rare and brilliant gem. Sells for its full value.

name: Flawless gem (5,000 gp)
desc: A flawless gem of great size. Sells for its full value.

name: Art object (25 gp)
desc: A small carved or engraved keepsake. Sells for its full value.

name: Fine art object (250 gp)
desc: A finely worked piece of jewelry or sculpture. Sells for its full value.

name: Masterwork art object (750 gp)
desc: A masterwork of a famous craftsman. Sells for its full value.

name: Treasured art object (2,500 gp)
desc: A treasure fit for a noble house. Sells for its full value.

name: Priceless art object (7,500 gp)
desc: A royal heirloom. Sells for its full value.

name: Arrows
desc: Shot from a shortbow or longbow; each shot uses one. Sold 20 for 1 gp (1 lb). After a fight you can gather up half of what you shot.

name: Blowgun Needles
desc: Shot from a blowgun; each shot uses one. Sold 50 for 1 gp (1 lb).

name: Crossbow Bolts
desc: Shot from any crossbow; each shot uses one. Sold 20 for 1 gp (1.5 lb).

name: Sling Bullets
desc: Shot from a sling; each shot uses one. Sold 20 for 4 cp (1.5 lb).

name: Thieves' Tools
desc: Pick locks and disarm traps. Proficiency adds your proficiency bonus.

name: Burglar's Pack
desc: A backpack, a bag of 1,000 ball bearings, 10 feet of string, a bell, 5 candles, a crowbar, a hammer, 10 pitons, a hooded lantern, 2 flasks of oil, 5 days rations, a tinderbox, a waterskin and 50 feet of hempen rope.

name: Diplomat's Pack
desc: A chest, 2 cases for maps and scrolls, fine clothes, a bottle of ink, an ink pen, a lamp, 2 flasks of oil, 5 sheets of paper, a vial of perfume, sealing wax and soap.

name: Dungeoneer's Pack
desc: A backpack, a crowbar, a hammer, 10 pitons, 10 torches, a tinderbox, 10 days of rations, a waterskin and 50 feet of hempen rope.

name: Entertainer's Pack
desc: A backpack, a bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, 5 days of rations, a waterskin and a disguise kit.

name: Explorer's Pack
desc: A backpack, a bedroll, a mess kit, a tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, a waterskin and 50 feet of hempen rope.

name: Priest's Pack
desc: A backpack, a blanket, 10 candles, a tinderbox, vestments, 2 days of rations and a waterskin (the alms box, incense and censer are left out).

name: Scholar's Pack
desc: A backpack, a book of lore, a bottle of ink, an ink pen and 10 sheets of parchment (the bag of sand and small knife are left out).
